subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hi, my card was charged twice for the Pro plan on Sept 3. Please refund one.

subject: Refund request
body: I signed up 5 days ago but the product isn't for me. Can I get my money back?

subject: Cancel my subscription
body: How do I cancel? I don't want to be charged next month.

subject: Invoice for my company
body: Can you send me an invoice with our VAT number for last month's payment?

subject: Charged after I cancelled!!!
body: I cancelled two weeks ago and you charged me AGAIN. This is the third time I'm writing. Refund me now or I'm disputing it with my bank.

subject: App crashes on login
body: Since the latest update the iOS app closes immediately when I tap Log in. Reinstalling didn't help.

subject: Export not working
body: I requested a data export yesterday and still have no email. Is it stuck?

subject: URGENT: production is down
body: URGENT: production is down for all users, nobody on our team can log in or load any page.

subject: Dark mode?
body: Love the app! Is there a dark mode, or is it planned?

subject: Slow dashboard
body: The dashboard takes about 10 seconds to load today. It still works, just slow.

subject: Someone else logged into my account
body: I got an email about a login from a country I've never been to, and my email address was changed. I think my account was hacked.

subject: Forgot password
body: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. I checked spam.

subject: Lost my phone, locked out
body: I lost my phone with the authenticator app and I can't find my backup codes. I need access for work tomorrow.

subject: Change email address
body: I'm moving jobs. How do I change the email on my account to my personal one?

subject: Delete my account
body: Please delete my account and all my data.

subject: Where is my order?
body: I ordered 8 days ago with standard shipping and tracking hasn't updated since Monday.

subject: Package says delivered but it isn't here
body: Tracking says delivered yesterday but there's nothing at my door, and my neighbours don't have it.

subject: Shipping to Canada
body: Do you ship to Canada and how long does it take?

subject: Wrong address on order
body: I just placed an order and noticed the street number is wrong. It hasn't shipped yet, can you fix it?

subject: Thanks!
body: Just wanted to say your support team was great last week. Keep it up.

subject: Partnership inquiry
body: We run a newsletter with 50k readers and would like to discuss a partnership.

subject: All my projects are gone
body: I logged in this morning and every one of my projects has disappeared. Years of work. Please help immediately.

subject: quick question about billing date
body: Hey, totally not a big deal, but can I move my billing date from the 3rd to the 15th?

subject: Double charge and app crash
body: Two problems: I was charged twice this month, and the Android app crashes when I open settings. The charge matters most to me.
